table_of_contents.title: If only lightning would strike him!
Seven years had passed since their last meeting, but Dominic Maxwell still found Fenella Gardner's morals suspect. She was--and always would be--a gold digger.

The fact he had misjudged her wouldn't have normally bothered Fenella. At least not if Fala'isi, an island in the South Pacific, hadn't been so small, and not if he'd kept his opinions to himself. Fenella didn't want her young half brother Mark to be hurt by Dominic's arrogant assumptions.
And Fenella wouldn't have cared what Dominic thought of her if his opinion hadn't really mattered--if the attraction between them hadn't been so strong.

description.value:
After her husband Afton, Lord of Langley, falls prey to a deadly plague, Englishwoman Igrania finds herself captive to her own castle... held hostage by Scottish warrior Eric Graham, whose wife and son- prisoners of Lord Langley- have also perished there.
To Graham, Igrainia is merely a political pawn, a pretty prize to dangle in front of the English king. But when the king refuses to trade- Igrainia for the wife of Scotland's ruler Robert the Bruce- Graham forces Igrainia to marry him, through the proud noblewoman would rather not in her own dungeons than accept one gesture of kindness from her captor. 
What Graham never expects is the desire that his strong-willed bride stirs in his soul. And when Igrainia discovers the true heart of the fearsome knight, her life- and loyalties- will never be the same....
